premises.text: Mobile app development is hard, requires many languages/frameworks, is expensive (average ~$27k), and takes months before anything ships
premises.evidence_span: mobile application development is hard. It requires knowledge of many programming languages, technologies, and frameworks. And because of that, it's expensive

premises.text: Non-technical users can drag-and-drop a library of components to build native mobile apps with PowerPoint-like ease, including live on-device preview
premises.evidence_span: a non-technical user can drag and drop components and build their own awesome mobile app

premises.text: App Architect sits between inflexible template builders and developer-only tools by combining template simplicity with full customization
premises.evidence_span: We have the simplicity of templates, but you can customize the app in every single way

domains.name: easy and flexible vs templates or code tools

value.text: Anyone who can build a PowerPoint can become a mobile app developer and ship their own app
value.evidence_span: if you can build a PowerPoint slide deck, you too can become a mobile app developer
